title: %isDate - date-type test
purpose: Return true when a value is a date or timestamp type.
notes: True for both date and timestamp types.
An ISO string arriving as text is a string, not a date - %coerceDate promotes it to a real date first.

avoid.why: when born arrives as the plain string "2020-01-15" its type is string, so %isDate returns ?false despite looking date-like. Coerce with %coerceDate before testing.
